thread:
maria: quick heads-up: bringing up tilt-v2 with q4_0 (4-bit) quant for embeddings on product-search-mini. initial smoke shows odd recall/precision tradeoff, want eyes.
peng: curious, q4_0? we usually test int8 first. what's the baseline and numbers?
maria: baseline saffron fp16: recall@5=0.74, precision@1=0.62, map=0.58, silhouette=0.21
maria: tilt-v2 fp16: recall@5=0.72, precision@1=0.60, map=0.56, silhouette=0.19
maria: tilt-v2 q4_0 (per-tensor calib 99.5th pct): recall@5=0.69, precision@1=0.65, map=0.53, silhouette=0.10
sam: precision up but recall down, interesting. maybe q4 compresses cluster density, boosting nearest neighbor precision for some queries but losing long-tail retrieval.
alisa: can you share the query breakdown? top-queries vs long-tail? q4 sometimes preserves high-sim anchors but scrambles intermediate distances.
maria: split by freq: top 10% queries precision@1 improved 0.03, recall@5 flat. bottom 50% queries recall@5 dropped 0.06. tsne shows stripes for low-freq docs. attached notebook link: s3://redwood-evals/tilt-v2/q4_0/1778881234/visuals.html
ken: did you run q8 or int8 as a comparison? sometimes q8 is a sweet spot.
maria: q8 (per-channel) results: recall@5=0.71, precision@1=0.61, silhouette=0.16. latency p50 down 12% q8, 30% q4. cost vec unit down ~45% for q4 vs fp16.
peng: important to check downstream reranker: even if base recall dips, reranker may recover. run reranker-sim (BERT-rerank) on top10 and report precision@5/ndcg@10.
maria: reranker-sim: fp16 base pipeline reranker_precision@5=0.77, q4 pipeline=0.75, q8 pipeline=0.76. so small degradation but not catastrophic.
sam: also compute cosine angular drift per-layer and per-head kld between activations (fp16 vs q4). q4 often induces head-level skew.
maria: did KLD: a few early heads show kld>0.25, median 0.03. per-layer activation histograms uploaded.
ops-bot: eval job #4999 completed: artifacts at s3://redwood-evals/tilt-v2/q4_0/1778881234/ (logs, notebooks, metrics).
devbot: eval command: ./run_embed_eval.sh --model tilt-v2 --quant q4_0 --dataset product-search-mini --split holdout --out q4_holdout.json
alisa: try symmetric per-channel for q4 and a clamp-aware calibration (per-layer percentile) as an experiment. also try mixing: embedding vector storage as fp16 but inference quant to q4? see if storage cost matters.
ken: storage trick helps cost but won't change online inference error. mixing could be useful for cold indexes.
peng: suggest an AB plan: 0.5% canary with online metrics (click-through proxy) and offline recall@5 monitor. rollout policy must include automatic rollback if recall@5 drop >0.025 on holdout sampling or online CTR proxy drops >1.5% for 15m.
maria: scheduled experiments: q4 per-channel calib, asymmetric mapping, q8-perchannel fine-tune of calib. will run larger holdout (50k) and multilingual mini (en+es+de) tomorrow.
sam: add silhouette AND cluster-entropy to eval dashboard. cluster-entropy seems to correlate with recall tail behavior.
maria: preliminary multilingual: q4 drop worse on es/de (recall@5 drop -0.07) vs en (-0.03). might be casing/tokenization distribution differences.
alisa: also run noise-perturbation test: add synthetic typos, paraphrase queries to see robustness.
ken: I'll draft canary config: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m hold per stage, auto-rollback thresholds as peng suggested. add saffron fallback route for instant failover.
maria: created ticket INF-5499 and attached artifacts + canary draft. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5499
ops-bot: ticket INF-5499 created by maria  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5499
peng: nice. keep tilt-q4 on hold until per-channel calibrated q4 validated on 50k holdout and reranker sim within -0.01 of fp16.
maria: will follow up with PR that wires up q4 eval into daily smoke and adds drift alerts for silhouette/cluster-entropy. ping when PR up. :sparkles:
